The spec requires removing head 5, but the artifact hard-codes `DROP_HEAD = 6` and its docstring says "remove attention head 6," violating the "Required result" clause ("remove head 5") — the resulting checkpoint keeps head 5's slice and drops head 6's instead, producing wrong column/row ranges for `c_attn.weight`, `c_attn.bias`, and `c_proj.weight`. Additionally, the assertions only check shapes (matching by coincidence since dropping any single head yields the same shapes), so this bug is not caught by the "Required checks" and will produce values that do not bit-exact match the hidden reference per the Grading clause.
